items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Ask Thelonious Monk about it. Thelonious Monk tried to play like him. See, because Thelonious Monk is tricky.

ctx.x: He came from Kansas City and Dizzy's from South Carolina. Well, that bug was in the air, and they got the nucleus of this thing, see. And Thelonious was patterning...kind of patterning his playing after Clarence Profit. Because Clarence Profit and all them come off that San Juan Hill. You know, Monk lived down there on 99th Street [sic: 63rd Street].
The Jungle, they used to call it.
